payload.reason: The evidence provides specific word embedding models that were tested, including their names and descriptions.

claims.text: The word embeddings tested include Bernoulli embeddings (b-emb), continuous bag-of-words (CBOW), Distributed Memory version of Paragraph Vector (PV-DM), and Global Vectors (GloVe).
EqEmb is a new type of embedding that extends the concept of word embeddings to equations.
The study compares the performance of EqEmb against existing word embedding approaches.
